description: Metric to assert a latency threshold on a test case.
quote: Add `LatencyMetric` and `CostMetric` so you can assert performance and spend thresholds in evaluations.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. REMOVED in 2024-04 (PR #706: "Remove the `LatencyMetric`, `CostMetric`, and `JudgementalGPT` metrics and their documentation"), so not available now; listed only as a removed item. Threshold assertion on user-supplied latency, not a measurement.

description: Metric to assert a spend threshold on a test case.
quote: Add `LatencyMetric` and `CostMetric` so you can assert performance and spend thresholds in evaluations.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. REMOVED in 2024-04 (PR #706), so not available now; listed only as a removed item.

metric_name: Evaluation cost tracking in metric metadata
description: Cost of running the evaluation is recorded in metric metadata and aggregated into the test run total.
quote: Add evaluation cost tracking to metric metadata and test runs, and aggregate per-test costs into the total run cost.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. Cost of the evaluator LLM calls, not of the agent run; probably out of M1 scope.

metric_name: Token-level streaming timestamps on LLM spans
description: Each emitted token is recorded with a precise ISO time on LLM tracing spans.
quote: Add token-level streaming timestamps to LLM tracing spans, recording each emitted token with a precise ISO time to help analyze generation latency and pacing.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. Framework tracing; raw timestamps, no named time-to-first-token metric in this entry (Confident AI platform lists TTFT separately).

metric_name: Safety metrics (10 new: harmful/illegal instructions, misinformation, graphic content, prompt extraction, IP, manipulation, risky commands)
description: Ten safety metrics added in one entry; individual names not given in the entry.
quote: Add 10 new safety metrics to detect PII leakage, harmful or illegal instructions, misinformation, graphic content, prompt extraction, role boundary violations, IP issues, manipulation, and risky command execution.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. Names not stated; PII Leakage and Role Violation are already recorded or set aside. Probably red-team vulnerability-style checks.
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Policy and moderation violations; Sensitive data leakage

description: Input and output token usage of the evaluator model is tracked per metric and shown next to evaluation cost.
quote: Add tracking and reporting of input and output token usage for metrics, allowing users to see token counts alongside evaluation cost.
note: DeepEval changelog gives the month only, not the day; entry_date is the first of that month. Tokens of the judge model, not of the agent run; probably out of M1 scope.

metric_name: LLM span attributes: cache tokens, reasoning tokens, time to first token (Confident AI)
description: LLM spans capture cache tokens, reasoning tokens, time to first token and other attributes.
quote: LLM spans now capture cache tokens, reasoning tokens and text, temperature, top-k, top-p, streaming, reasoning effort, output type, time to first token, and image tokens.
note: Platform changelog. Temperature, top-k, top-p, streaming flag, reasoning effort and output type are request parameters, not measurements, and are not proposed.
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Cached tokens; Reasoning tokens; Time to first token

metric_name: LLM Analytics: cost, calls, latency, tokens per span (Confident AI)
description: Shows LLM cost per trace and the most expensive spans with calls, average cost and total cost, switchable to cost, latency or tokens.
quote: See LLM cost per trace and your most expensive spans across all traces, with calls, average cost, and total cost for each.
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Estimated cost; LLM call count; LLM call latency; Total tokens

description: Shows which tool fails most often and which arguments get called most frequently.
quote: See which tool fails most often, which arguments get called most frequently, and which agent is most likely to pick the wrong tool.
note: Platform changelog. "Pick the wrong tool" is not mapped (not stated how it is measured).
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Tool execution errors; Tool call count

description: Live map of how agents call tools and models across traced requests, highlighting failures, errors and latency.
quote: a live map of how your agents call tools and models across every traced request, with the trouble spots—failures, errors, latency—lighting up right where they cluster.
note: Platform changelog; beta; which exact measures are shown is not stated, so the mapping is tentative.
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Tool call count; Tool execution errors; Tool execution latency

description: Threads total input and output tokens across the conversation, alongside input and output cost.
quote: Threads now total input and output tokens across the whole conversation, alongside input and output cost.
proposed_taxonomy_metric: Input tokens; Output tokens; Estimated cost

metric_name: Cost per user (Confident AI User Analytics)
description: Total cost per user shown in the users table.
quote: Total cost per user in the table, User ID filter on the Threads page, and click-through from Users to Traces.

description: Automatically detects issues, sentiment and behavioural patterns across incoming traces.
quote: Signals automatically detects issues, sentiment, and behavioral patterns across all incoming traces
note: Platform changelog; beta; generic classifier-style feature, built-in status and exact outputs unclear.
